newsitem.title: USA: Grand Casinos may end Stratosphere Ch11 pact.
newsitem.headline: Grand Casinos may end Stratosphere Ch11 pact.

text.p: Grand Casinos Inc said Wednesday that it may end its participation in a reorganization plan for Stratosphere Corp because Stratosphere could not meet terms of a present arrangement.

Grand Casinos said the existing plan required Stratosphere to obtain average monthly consolidated cash flow of $2.267 million between October 1 and June 30. However Stratosphere's average monthly consolidated cash flow for the six-month period ending March 31 was $1.727 million, Grand Casinos said.
Grand Casinos said it will not waive the minimum cash flow requirement but that it is prepared to explore alternatives.
If an alternative arrangement cannot be reached, it said it could propose an alternative plan of reorganization or end its participation in the Stratosphere bankruptcy process.
Stratosphere, which runs a tower casino and hotel in Las Vegas, filed for Chapter 11 protection in January.
